s: On this day, His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj performed the sacred murti-pratishtha of Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj and various other murtis at the BAPS Hindu Mandir in Johannesburg. Currently, these consecrated murtis are enshrined in the cultural complex,…

l: Mahant Swami Maharaj consecrates the BAPS Hindu Mandir in Johannesburg
c: Performs murti pratishtha at the mandir
s: On this day in 2025, on Vasant Panchmi, Mahant Swami Maharaj performed the murti pratishtha of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj at the BAPS Hindu Mandir in Johannesburg.

l: Mahant Swami Maharaj performs murti pratishtha at the Prarthana Mandir in Surat
c: Performs murti pratishtha at the mandir
s: On the auspicious morning of Akshaya Trutiya, Mahant Swami Maharaj performs the murti-pratishtha of Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj and the Gunatit Guru Parampara at the Prarthana Mandir in the campus of BAPS Swaminarayan Akshardham, Surat.

l: Mahant Swami Maharaj consecrates the murtis of the Prarthana Mandir in Surat
c: Performs murti pratishtha at the mandir
s: On this day in 2025, on Akshaya Trutiya, Mahant Swami Maharaj performed the murti pratishtha of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj and the Guru Parampara at the Prarthana Mandir in Surat.

l: Mahant Swami Maharaj inaugurates the new shikharbaddh mandir in Jodhpur
s: Mahant Swami Maharaj inaugurates the new shikharbaddh BAPS Swaminarayan mandir in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, India.

l: King Charles III and Queen Camilla visit Neasden Temple for its 30th year
s: King Charles III and Queen Camilla of the UK visit the Neasden Temple to commemorate its 30th anniversary. They viewed a special video message from Mahant Swami Maharaj in the assembly.
h: The King and Queen visit Neasden Mandir

l: Mahant Swami Maharaj honours over 15,000 children who learnt Satsang Diksha
c: Honours the children of Mission Rajipo
s: In a divine historic sabha, Mahant Swami Maharaj honours the over 15,000 children who completed the mukpath of the Satsang Diksha. Swamishri wrote a sankalp exactly one year ago on Diwali 2024 to say he wishes 10,000 children memorise the Satsang Diksha.…

l: Mahant Swami Maharaj celebrates the Pramukh Varni Amrut Mahotsav in Ahmedabad
s: On Pramukh Swami Maharaj’s birth anniversary, on the banks of the sacred River Sabarmati in Ahmedabad, Mahant Swami Maharaj marked 75 years since Shastriji Maharaj appointed the young Narayanswarup Swami as president or 'Pramukh' of BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha.

l: Mahant Swami Maharaj receives a Guinness World Records certificate for children
c: Receives a Guinness World Records award
s: Mahant Swami Maharaj receives Guinness World Records certificate recognising the largest simultaneous Hindu text recital.
h: A Guinness World Record for Satsang Diksha

l: Mahant Swami Maharaj unveils the 108 foot murti of Nilkanth Varni at Akshardham
s: On the auspicious occasion of Bhagwan Swaminarayan's 245th birth anniversary — observed according to the Hindu lunar calendar — Mahant Swami Maharaj inaugurated the 108-foot-tall murti of Tapomurti Shri Nilkanth Varni Maharaj at Swaminarayan Akshardham,…

l: Mahant Swami Maharaj inaugurates a 108 foot murti of Nilkanth Varni in New Delhi
s: On this day in 2026, on Bhagwan Swaminarayan's birth anniversary, Mahant Swami Maharaj inaugurated the 108 foot tall murti of Tapomurti Shri Nilkanth Varni in New Delhi.

l: Mahant Swami Maharaj names his UK and Europe tour the Yogi Anjali Yatra
c: Names his yatra the Yogi Anjali Yatra
s: On this day in 2026, before leaving for Paris, Mahant Swami Maharaj named his UK and Europe yatra the Yogi Anjali Yatra, an offering to Yogiji Maharaj.

l: Mahant Swami Maharaj arrives in Paris to open the first stone mandir in France
s: On this day in 2026, Mahant Swami Maharaj arrived in Paris to open the first traditional stone Hindu mandir in France.
